items.text: Eiteng'enishe Yesu enkomono
Neaku ore eomonito te dikae wueji, ore pee eidip, nejoki obo loo looiteng'eni lenyena, “Olaitoriani, inteng'ena iyiook enkomono anaa enaiteng'ena Yohana ilooiteng'eni lenyena.”
Nejoki, “Ti niomonono entejo:
Nejoki ninche, “Kalo linyi oota lchore laa te nelo ainyeyie eitorite enkewarie, ajoki, ‘Olchore, isilenokoki mukateni uni;
amu eewuo olchore lai eing'uaa nkang'itie nemaata entoki naisho.’
Kejoki ilo otii aji, ‘Mikintanyamal, amu eikeno kutuk aji, neirurate nkera, kirurate pooki. Meekure aidim ainyo pee aaisho?’
Ajoki ntae, te nemeisho duoo te nkaraki naa olchore lenye, kake ore enkaraki naitirrishaka olikae, einyototo ake aisho naaba anaa naayieu.
Najoki naa ntae, entoomonu pee eishori ntae, eng'oru pee itumutumu; entooshiosh kutuk aji pee eboluni ntae.
Amu ore pooki oomonu netum; ore oloing'oru netum; ore olooshiosh kutuk aji neboluni.
“Kalo te ntae oisho enkerai enye osoit etoomonuo emukate? Aashu te neomonu osinkirri, keisho olasurai?
Aashu te neomonu olmosori, keisho enkulupa?
Asa taa doi iyiololo ntae iltung'ana torrok, aaisho nkera inyi ntokitin sidain, kebaa na aitulus Papa linyi otii keper aisho Enkiyang'et Sinyati lelo oomon ninye?”
Yesu o Beelsebul
Nearaa oloirirua lemeiro. Neaku ore pee epuku ilo oirirua lemeiro, neiro ilo tung'ani apa oonyo kutuk, neing'asia olorere.
Mat 9.34
Kake etejo kulikae lenye, “Beelsebul, olkitok loo loiriruani, oishoo engolon naararie loiriruani.”
Netem sii kulikae eing'oru osapiipiyiet oing'uaa keper.
Kake ore pee eirrash ndamunot enye, nejoki, “Ore enkitoria ake ninye pooki naoro aara oopeny neidaaya, ore enkaji naara openy neurori.
Kaji eiko Shetani te neoro aara makewan, keitoki enkitoria enye auno? Amu ijojo naa te ngolon e Beelsebul aaraa loiriruani?
Naa omaa te naa kengolon e Beelsebul aararie nanu loiriruani, kengolon e ng'ae doi aararie ninche nkera inyi loiriruani? Ninche naa ooyooki aaiguanare ntae.
Kake te naa ai to lkimojino le Nkai aaraa loiriruani, enkitoria e Nkai naewuo atua ntae.
Ore te nerrip oltung'ani ogol otanape enkaji enye, neserian imasaa enyena pooki.
Kake te nerasaki ologol alang ninye nemir, neoru masaa o larrabal duoo naawuasare, nelo aor iyarunot naatarua.
“Ore pooki leme ole nkalo ai, nau ekesh, ore ole maaret osotu, naa keisardaikie.
Pee epuku oloirirua oiduruk to ltung'ani
“Ore te neidur oloirirua oiduruk to ltung'ani nelo aimaa iwuejitin nemetii enkare, eing'oru eneyeng'iyeng'are; ore pee elau, nejo, ‘Kashukokino enkaji ai apa natung'uayie.’
Ore pee ebau, neinepu etooroki neikodi,
neito ninye alo aipot kulikae oiriruani oopishana torrok aalang ninye, meetu aamany ine; nerruoyo empukunoto e ilo tung'ani enatiu apa te dukuya.”
Emayianata nara
Ore pee ejo neijia, nebuaku enkitok nabo ti atua olorora nejoki, “Emayiana sii ake enkoshoke nikitoiwuo o lki likintanaaki.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ee paa emayiana aaisul, ilooning ele rorei le Nkai neibung.”
Eetuo kulikae aaing'oru embae enking'asia
Mat 16.4
Ore pee eiturrurrokino esiamo Yesu neiter ajoki, “Arruok sii ake ltung'ana lena kata, embae eing'oru; kake meetae naa embae enking'asia naishori neme e Yona.
Yon 3.4
Amu ore anaa enataa Yona embae enking'asia too ltung'ana le Ninawi, neijia sii etiu Enkerai e Tung'ani too ltung'ana le na kata.

Eyooki enkaiguanani e kopikop adumunye te nkiguana oo ltung'ana lena ishoi nedung'oki ninche enkiguana, amu eewuo ninye too neeiting'ie enkop elotu ainining eng'eno e Solomon, naa ng'ura, etii ene olkitok olang Solomon.
Yon 3.5

Eyooki ltung'ana le Ninawi aaitasheiki neitang'or ltung'ana le na ishoi, te nkolong e nkiguana, nedung'oki enkiguana, amu eirridutua ninche etolikio Yona ororei le Nkai, naa ng'ora, etii taa ene olkitok olang Yona.
Ewang'an o sesen
Mat 5.15
“Meetae oltung'ani oinok oltaa nepik orunku aashu epising to ltoo, kake epik eneiperere pee eitawang'aki iloojing'u.
Etiu nkonyek inono anaa oltaa lo sesen lino, naa te naa biyot nkonyek inono, newang osesen lino pooki; kake ore pee kira torrok nkonyek nerip enaimin osesen lino pooki.
Toduaa naa pee miaku ewang'an niata enaimin.
Amu te nebore osesen lino pooki ewang'an, nemeeta enemisimis, newang'u pooki wueji, atiu anaa te nikilang oltaa owang.”
Eitangoro Yesu Lfarisayo o lasirak
Ore eirorita Yesu, neipot Olfarisayoi obo meshomo anya endaa te nkaji enye, nelo, neton anya endaa.
Neing'asia ilo Farisayoi pee edol ajo eitu eng'as aisuj inkaik eitu enya endaa.
Kake etiaka Olaitoriani ilo farisayioi, “Intukuku ntae Lfarisayo oriong enkikompe o esaani, kake ore atua ntae ebore enkowuarisho o enkarruoisho.
Lo moda! Ai me ele obo oitobira oriong o atua?
Kake enchoru to lng'ur nena tokitin naatii atua, naa ng'ura, kesinyayu pooki toki te ntae.
Ilaw 27.30
“Kake ee kake aiyia ntae lo Farisayo! Amu nchoruru ematua e tomon oo ntasimi oo mbenek pooki nipalaa enkiguana oo sipat o enyorrata e Nkai, naa eishiaakino nitaasa nimipalaa nena kulie.
Ee kake aiyia ntae Ilfarisayo! Amu inyorrinyorro lorikan sidain too nkajijik entumo, ninyorrinyorro lng'asak too wuejitin neemirishoreki.
Ee kake aiyia ntae! Amu itiuu anaa nkuraren nemelioo, naaitunyoo ltung'ana meyiolo.”
Newaliki obo loo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ajoki, “Olaiteng'enani, te nijo nji, iyiook sii iyiet.”
Nejoki, “Ee kake ayia sii ntae ilang'eni loo nkitanapat! Amu intanapinapa ilkulikae ilolan ooiroishi lemenapayu, ore ntae maate nimiseyieyie too lkimojik linyi.
Ee kake ayia! Amu ishetishete nkuraren oo iloibonok le Nkai laa papaai linyi ootaara metuata.
Metaa, itaa shakeni, nitonyorraitie nkiasin oo loo minyi, amu ninche ootaara metuata, nishetakiki ntae nkuraren.
“Ore enkaraki ina, etejo, eng'eno e Nkai, ‘Kairriwaki ninche loibonok o lkipaareta, near kulikae metuata, nearaa kulikae’,
paa ore ilo sarge loo loibonok le Nkai, oibukoyioki ebaiki apa pee eitamanyuni enkop, neitalakuni ltung'ana le na ishoi;
Enk 4.8
ebaiki osarge le Abel o metabaiki osarge le Sakaria, oitanang'aki erishata olperere lo lasar o ewueji sinyati ee ajoki intae keitalakuni too ltung'ana lena ishoi.
Entodol ake ate te nkeleekisho
“Ee kake aiyia lang'eni loo nkitanapat! Amu iwaita embolet najing'ieki ewueji e ng'eno; neitu ijing'ijing'i ntae maate nirishieshie lelo oojing'ita.
“Ore eing'uaa ine, neiteru lasirak o Lfarisayo aaitirrishaki oleng, nerrumoki meimaki imbaa kumok
erreshu enaitang'orie te nena naajo ninye.”
